coreAegisLogistics.text: Core Aegis logistics space — major Fleet anchorages, relief stores, convoy assembly points and repair infrastructure where protection is planned before a crisis begins. Ordered Core systems meet the messy realities of damaged ships, civilian schedules and finite supplies.

vergeConvoyRoutes.text: Verge convoy routes — long working corridors connecting farms, freeports, settlements and markets that cannot assume immediate Fleet support. Civilian captains know local timing, failure points and practical route behavior, and their experience should be treated as operational knowledge rather than folklore.

interFactionCorridors.text: Inter-faction corridors — shared transit volumes where Core, Verge, Shard and independent traffic overlap. Rescue and escort decisions can carry diplomatic consequences even when the immediate problem is purely physical.

latticeRescueEdge.text: Lattice rescue edge — stabilized space near unreliable folds, survey boundaries and corridor failures. Geometry, timing and safe approach paths may change, so protection often depends on disciplined measurement and conservative navigation rather than speed.
